# Test-period results (single run) - generated by `scripts/run_test_evaluation.py`

Evaluation targets 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-24. Git commit `155b206265`, dataset sha256 `ee5bc65756cd7976...`. Frozen configuration: `docs/experiment_protocol.md` section 15. Models are fitted on the training period only; trees and epochs fixed from validation; headline = mean prediction of 3 seeds. Tuning budgets differ between models (XGBoost 90 trials per horizon, LSTM 12 + 12). Scenario A except where labelled oracle.
